description: This PHP source file defines the 'FieldSettings' class, a Drupal migration process plugin for handling field settings during data migration from Drupal 6 to Drupal 8/9/10. It includes methods for retrieving and merging field configuration settings, with deprecation notices indicating it is obsolete in Drupal 11.3 and later.

classes.name: FieldSettings
classes.description: A Drupal migration process plugin class for handling field settings during data migration, including merging default and specified settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that triggers a deprecation warning and initializes the plugin.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms input data to retrieve field settings, ensuring backward compatibility.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Merges default Drupal 8 settings with specified Drupal 6 settings, returning configuration based on field type.
